definition: סְגוֺר noun [masculine] enclosure, encasement ; — construct סְגוֺר לִבָּם Hos 13:8 the encasement of their heart ( pericardium ; i.e. their vitals). — סְגוֺר Job 28:15 must = fine gold , si vera lectio, but see סגר , Qal. near the end ; סְגֹר Ps 35:3 see id. , Qal 2 b.
